surface.purpose: a global Biology master switch plus one Biology-owned E3-inspired presentation preference
surface.notes: The semantic settings API is Biology-owned and provider-neutral. Mod Settings is only the current UI/persistence adapter. When Biology is enabled, one authored physical simulation runs with no subsystem or balance tuning. The global master switch may disable the complete overhaul; the only other editable setting controls Biology's E3-inspired HUD/nameplate presentation.

developmentFeedbackFallback.rule: Attended feedback explicitly accepted barless actor presentation for Biology-on play. The E3 preference does not own health-bar suppression. Turning the global Biology master switch off restores native HUD/nameplate behavior.

publicControls.description: Turns the complete Biology overhaul on or off. Reload the current save after changing it so every adapter begins from the same state.
Toggles Biology's red E3-inspired first-person HUD and NPC-nameplate visual layer. The physical simulation, barless-health policy, and native modern scanner/quickhack interface remain unchanged.

developmentRules: Development profile keys exist only to isolate authorities during compilation, calibration and attended diagnosis.
A release builder fixes gameplay/presentation authority keys to the release profile and diagnostics off.
Individual development authority gates are never persisted as normal player preferences.
The global Biology master switch is the sole player control allowed to stop the authored overhaul as a whole.

The E3-inspired HUD preference may suppress only Biology-owned E3-specific visual skin/nameplate presentation; underlying physical state, the barless-health policy, and consequences continue unchanged while Biology remains enabled.
Provider-specific UI/persistence code may adapt these two booleans but may not own or redefine their semantics.
binaryPreferenceRule: Public booleans are limited to the complete Biology master switch and the E3-inspired presentation preference. No individual physical authority, rate, damage, protection, injury, pain, treatment or recovery parameter is player-tunable.
